system.description:
A Samurai of Arcane Might II or greater may grant a portion of their Martial Spirit to those that follow them, allowing them to benefit from Oni’s Might and Steel Body as if they possessed Arcane Might I in those abilities. The Samurai may revoke this grant at any time and may bestow it with an action to a willing target. When it is revoked the target suffers 4d4 Stress, unless it is done with appropriate ceremony such as when a warrior retires.

Retainers may be converted to use the Samurai Retainer unit stats and gain the associated benefits when being led by their Samurai.

Samurai may maintain ten retainers at Arcane Might II, a hundred at Arcane Might IV and a thousand at Arcane Might VI.
